title: prune grading answers line
description: One answer per line of grading/<grader>.answers.jsonl, written by whoever graded: a judgment model, a subagent (answered_by agent) or a human. Same shape as the mine answers, with a boolean answer. `scripts/prune.mjs` reads it back and lists gaps.

question_id.description: The id of the questions line this answers.

answer.description: true when the output follows the rule.

confidence.description: The probability that answer is right.

distribution.description: Optional probability per outcome, keyed true and false.

model.description: The judgment model's ID when answered_by is judgment-model. Data only.
